document.abstract: A description of the new laboratory of Consolidated Film Industries, Inc., at Hollywood, Calif., completed during the winter of 1936–37. Included are lay-outs and illustrations of equipment on several of the floors. The description of the laboratory and equipment follows the sequence of negative development, dailies, master and release printing, together with a description of the special printers, processing units, chemical system, silver-recovery system, and other mechanical items of interest.
